start: Add member sheet open; the gym has an archived member with mobile number X

steps.action: Type a name and mobile number X, tap "Add member"
user_sees: A red banner: "{archived member's name} already has this number. They are archived, so they are hidden from the list."
Buttons "Bring them back" and "Open their page"
The form stays open with what was typed
must_not: A second member with the same number
A plain "number taken" with no name
The sheet closing

user_sees: The sheet closes and that member's page opens; the member is back on the list
must_not: The name typed in the form written over the old member's name
A new member made as well
The old member's receipts or visits lost

start: Add member sheet showing the "already has this number… archived" banner

user_sees: The sheet closes and the archived member's page opens
must_not: The member un-archived by only looking
A new member saved

start: Add member sheet open; a member who is NOT archived has mobile number Y

steps.action: Type a name and mobile number Y, tap "Add member"
user_sees: Under Mobile number: "{name} already has this mobile number in Members."
No banner and no "Bring them back" button
must_not: A second member with the same number
A member of another gym named

start: Enquiries screen, "Add as member" on an enquiry whose number belongs to an archived member (form open and filled)

steps.action: Tap "Add member", then "Bring them back" on the banner
user_sees: The archived member is back and their page opens; the enquiry is marked joined, linked to that member
must_not: The enquiry left open
The enquiry linked to a member that does not exist

start: Add member sheet showing the archived banner; the internet is off

user_sees: The sheet stays open with a message that it did not work (the server's own words, or "Could not bring back that member. Please try again.")
must_not: The sheet closing as if it worked
The member shown as back when they are not

start: Add member sheet showing the archived banner

steps.action: Change one digit of the mobile number
user_sees: The banner goes away at once
must_not: "Bring them back" still offered for a number no longer typed

user_sees: The new member is saved with the new number; the archived member stays archived
must_not: The archived member brought back anyway

steps.action: Type a number that belongs to a member of this gym and tap "Add member"
user_sees: That member's name, to this gym's login only
must_not: The name of a person at another gym who has the same number
Whether a number is used by any other gym given away by the message
